messages:
Eli: quick sync We keep getting ad-hoc gateway transforms. let's create a minimal shim catalog + lifecycle so owners don't forget to retire them.
Maya: agreed. minimal fields: shim_id, owner, scope(tenant|global), type(header|body|response), created_at, expires_at, grade(stable/heuristic/temp), deps[]. also store a small test vector.
Vik: +1. recommend opt-in default for tenant scope. opt-in header sample: `X-Rw-Shim-OptIn: SHIM-2026-900` and a read-only status header `X-Rw-Shim-Status: applied|expired|missing`.
Rhea: runtime constraints: no arbitrary code in shims. only declarative mapping (copy/rename/scale) and simple regex replacements. complex fixes need a migration job.
Maya: DSL sketch (newline-separated rules, JSON-storable):
```
# copy field
user.name -> customer.displayName [copy]
# scale cents -> dollars
items[].price_cents -> items[].price_usd [scale:0.01]
# regex replace
meta.tag -> meta.tag [replace:/^v(\d+)$/:$1]
```
Eli: we need enforcement: gateway validates DSL and rejects rules that reference protected paths (e.g., `user.ssn`). each shim must declare data_sensitivity: low|medium|high. high is blocked until sec review.
Vik: monitoring hooks: shim_hit_pct, shim_latency_p95, shim_error_rate, shim_diff_rate (from smoke-checker). alert if error_rate delta > 2x or shim_diff_rate > 0.5%.
Rhea: smoke-checker: sample N requests in staging, run both shimmed and canonical path, diff normalized JSON. if diffs > threshold fail rollout. store diffs for owner review.
Maya: ownership rules: owner must set TTL. the system alerts at 7/3/1 days before expiry. if owner doesn't respond, auto-disable and open ticket. quarterly review required for long-lived shims.
Eli: billing: tag shims that route to compatibility-resources and annotate cost_center so infra charges map to owners. otherwise infra will eat the cost.
Vik: SDK side: emit `shim_applied` events with shim_id + dep_id + compat_score. provide deprecationCallback so apps can surface warnings in logs.
Rhea: docs: each shim entry needs a migration snippet, test vectors, and a short risk note. tie to RFC id.
Maya: rollout playbook: 1) create catalog entry + tests 2) enable staging for small % 3) run smoke-checker 4) monitor metrics 24-72h 5) expand to more tenants or rollback 6) retire when usage=0 and tests passing.
Eli: action items: Vik to prototype catalog API (ETA 4d), Maya to spec DSL + validation rules (ETA 3d), Rhea to add smoke-checker prototype (ETA 5d). I'll add console widgets for per-tenant shim lists (ETA 1w).
notify-bot: system: shim catalog entry SHIM-2026-900 created by Eli at 6150000032, staging rollout enabled for 2% tenants.
Maya: one more: machine ids `SHIM-YYYY-NNN` and `ARCH-YYYY-NNN` for per-deprecation traceability.
Eli: thanks all. we'll reconvene after staging signals. closing thread.
